findings.text: `unsetopt local_options nomatch` turns off `local_options` as well as `nomatch`, because both words are treated as options to unset. The `nomatch` change therefore isn't restored when `nvm_list_aliases` returns, and the user's interactive zsh keeps NOMATCH disabled. After running `nvm ls`, a typo such as `ls *.nonexistent` silently passes the literal pattern instead of erroring. The intended form is `setopt local_options nonomatch`.
